limitations: Evidence-completeness report only; priorities are research ordering, not legal conclusions, deployment approval or removal advice.
Source gap scopes use winner-only catalog coverage semantics, excluding more-specific known exceptions.
Absence from examined local evidence does not establish absence everywhere.

priority_definitions.P1: Original source/author/license or unknown derivative recipe to research first
priority_definitions.P2: Reproducibility, historical input chain or archive/install evidence to complete
priority_definitions.P3: Declared-but-absent optional artifacts or documentation completeness

schema.evidence: Existing local evidence supporting recorded facts, each with current file SHA256.
schema.foreign_keys: source_ids, package_ids and derivative_ids resolve to catalog.json collections; empty arrays mean not applicable.
schema.missing_fields: Machine-readable names for evidence not currently established; they are not legal assertions.
schema.scopes: Repository-relative POSIX scope predicates; source_ids additionally restrict a gap to winning source records. Scopes may overlap intentionally when distinct missing fields are reported.
